newsitem.title: USA: IMF, World Bank approve debt relief for Uganda.
newsitem.headline: IMF, World Bank approve debt relief for Uganda.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund and World Bank put their long-awaited aid plan for poor nations into practice on Wednesday by approving hundreds of millions of dollars of debt relief for Uganda.
"This will be the first use of multilateral debt relief," Jim Adams, World Bank Country Director for Uganda, told reporters.
The package for Uganda, which was approved as the IMF and World Bank prepared for the start of their semi-annual meeting, will reduce Uganda's $3.4 billion in debt by about a fifth.
